name: 🌯 Dad's Crunchy Burrito Roll-Ups
what: Chicken, rice and beans rolled tight with crushed chips inside, then fried golden.

core.name: Rice
core.out: skip it and add more beans

extras: black beans, frozen corn, taco seasoning, sour cream, avocado, salsa

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Start the rice, oven to 250°F.
Season the chicken and cook 6–7 minutes a side. Rest, then shred with two forks.
Mix the chicken, rice, beans, corn and half the cheese.
Warm a tortilla: cheese, filling, then crushed chips right before you roll it tight.
Fry seam side down in a little oil until golden, then flip. Keep warm in the oven.

key: Chips go in at the last second so they stay crunchy. Seam side down first to seal it.
done: Golden and crisp on both sides, chicken 165°F inside.
plan_b: Out of tortillas? Burrito bowls with chips crumbled on top.
